schema_note: One window only, the plan's recommended one. trip-windows/1 (overview spec 2.2) needs 2 to 4 windows, so this file keeps the same field names under trip-season-basic/1 and adds a `season` block in the adapter's Season shape. The plan names a second candidate later in summer; it was not researched here, so it is not a window in this file.
months_basis_note: The plan's own recommended window. The plan says summer with exact dates open and recommends about two weeks from the last week of June into early July (its Window A), chosen for midnight sun across the Arctic stops and to fall before the Norwegian common holiday weeks; it keeps a later candidate (Window B) as a fallback.

label.value: Last week of June into early July (dates still open)

why.value: The plan's recommended window: the sun does not set at the Lofoten and Tromso stations and the fjord coast has no real night.

tempC.value: 10 to 20 C in Bergen, 6 to 16 C in Tromso; Lofoten daily mean about 10 to 13 C
tempC.note: WMO 1991-2020, mean daily min to max, June / July: Bergen 10.1/12.4 to 17.7/19.6; Tromso 6.2/9.1 to 13.0/16.3. Leknes publishes only the daily mean: 9.7/12.7.

rain.value: Wet in Bergen, 13 to 15 rain days a month; about 11 in Tromso; Lofoten and Andalsnes about 90 to 100 mm a month
rain.note: June / July precipitation and days >= 1 mm: Bergen 132.3/157.5 mm, 13/15 days; Tromso 58/72.5 mm, 11/11 days; Reine 91.3/95.7 mm (days not published); Andalsnes 97.2/89.3 mm (days not published).

daylight.value: Midnight sun in Lofoten and Tromso; in Bergen sunrise about 04:10 to 04:30, sunset about 23:00 to 23:10
daylight.note: core/bin/sun.ts for the first and last day of the recommended window: Leknes and Tromso 'sun never sets' on both; Bergen sunrise 04:11 to 04:26, sunset 23:11 to 23:01, day 19h01m to 18h35m, no nautical night. Both days fall after the solstice, so the days between are as light or lighter.

notes.text: Bergen is the wettest stop, with rain on about half the days
No darkness at any station, so northern lights are not possible in this window

plus.text: Midnight sun at the Lofoten and Tromso stations
About 19 hours of daylight even in Bergen, with no real night
Tromso has fewer rain days than Bergen, about 11 a month

minus.text: Bergen gets rain on about half the days in this window
Cool in the north: Tromso afternoons about 13 to 16 C
No darkness, which can make sleep hard for some
minus.note: Follows from the computed sun times (no civil night in Lofoten and Tromso); the effect on sleep is our reading.
